mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_favorite (user_id, post_id, is_deleted, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{postId}, 0, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE is_deleted = IF(is_deleted = 0, 1, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM post_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT post_id FROM post_favorite WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post_favorite WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 0
